The deal loop

## How a deal actually closes

1. 01

### Agree a price

Offer, counter, accept. Nobody swaps contact details until there is a deal on the table.
2. 02

### Fund escrow

The buyer wires into escrow. Every line is itemized up front, including the provider's ~2.4% fee.
3. 03

### Hand over the keys

The buyer confirms each asset arrived, then the money moves. We take 5% only once it does.

### The revenue is real

Numbers come straight from the seller's own payment processor, read only. Not a spreadsheet, not a screenshot.

### The traffic is real

Pulled from the seller's analytics and matched to the domain they are actually selling.

### The people are real

Identity checks and two factor on both sides before a penny moves.

### Your money is never ours

A licensed provider holds it until you confirm everything arrived.

## The most affordable option

Free to browse. Free to list. Always free for buyers. Sellers pay a 5% success fee on finalized deals.
